INFORMATION  The total mark for this paper is 30.  Each correct answer will score one mark.  Any rough working should be done on this question paper.
Which item should be treated as capital expenditure?

options.A: cost of a printer for an existing computer system

options.D: repair costs to a car which are not covered by insurance

questions.questionText: A business has a financial year end of 31 December. It purchased a vehicle on 1 January 2019 for $30000. The business depreciates vehicles at the rate of 20% per annum using the reducing balance method. Depreciation is charged on a month-by-month basis. The vehicle was sold on 30 September 2021.

A trader bought a machine on 1 January 2019. He depreciated it at the rate of 10% per annum using the straight-line method. He sold this machine on 1 January 2021 for $4000. The profit on disposal was $200. How much had the machine cost on 1 January 2019?
Which item is recorded on the credit side of a sales ledger control account?

options.D: set-off of amounts in the purchases ledger

questions.questionText: The bank column of the cash book showed a credit balance of $2915. This did not agree with the balance shown on the bank statement. It was then discovered that:
The correction of which error would require an entry in the suspense account?

options.A: A sales invoice, $45, was omitted from the sales journal.
options.B: Drawings, $60, were debited in the cash book and were credited to the drawings account.
options.C: Vehicle repairs, $100, were debited to the vehicles at cost account.
options.D: Wages, $150, were correctly recorded in the wages account and debited in the cash book.
